subject: Music Production
title: Pharrell Williams and Genre Blending
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Pharrell Williams and Genre Blending.

hook.text: Pharrell Williams grew up listening to hip-hop, rock, and jazz in Virginia Beach.

buildup.text: He refused to stay in one genre, blending funk, rap, pop, and electronic sounds in every project.

discovery.text: The Neptunes created a spare, bouncy sound that defined pop and hip-hop in the early 2000s.

twist.text: His song 'Happy' became a global phenomenon, proving simple production achieves massive impact.

climax.text: Pharrell moved from beats to fashion to film scoring, expanding what a producer can become.

punchline.text: Refusing to pick one genre built a creative empire.

quiz.question: What was Pharrell's production duo called?
